changes: Device-local solo autosave every 15 seconds, pause/background checkpoints, durable Save & exit and paused Resume.
Versioned validated checkpoints with previous-good fallback; exact runtime state restoration and no online saves.
Explicit production rally flag, resource targeting through friendly workers and inherited gather orders.
Five representative illustrated map-style cards, expandable style picker, saved-match replacement notice.
Collapsible icon dock, portrait details, icon-and-cost tiles and compact Economy/Army sheets.

checks.scope: Four fresh processes; corruption, failed writes, exact banks/reservations/cargo, production, construction, trade, projectile single impact, fog, online exclusion.

checks.name: Browser storage transactions
checks.scope: fake-indexeddb transaction implementation: atomic rollback, fresh instance, stale-window overwrite/clear prevention, queue ordering, blocked storage and timeout.

checks.name: Existing browser infrastructure
checks.scope: 29 update tests, 6 audio-loader tests, 20 packaging tests.

checks.name: Compact controls
checks.scope: 27 real-HUD checks; 25 hold/release checks; two narrow/notched Strategy profiles; 15 native render states; 6056 menu layout and 2584 reflow checks.

checks.name: Rally behavior
checks.scope: Actual paid resource and military rally continuation; 22 both-owner authoritative command/production/snapshot and fixed-speed checks.

checks.name: Hands-on browser
checks.scope: 844x390 paid queues, flag/resource rally, Save & exit, fresh reload, offline cached launch with server stopped, continued production/gathering, app-update persistence, active-match Refresh protection; repeated save/reload/resume on public origin.

checks.name: Public multiplayer
checks.scope: Public WSS room host/join, all five map styles, synchronized setup, cancellation and recovery; source-frozen isolated clients.

checks.name: Deployment
checks.scope: Two reproducible committed exports, matching Linux server smoke, guarded activation, public file/source verification, online server replacement and web restart with no active match connections.

limitations: No physical iPhone/Android or OS-installed PWA lifecycle test. Cached offline browser reload and resume were observed.
Saves stay on the same browser/device; clearing site data or browser storage eviction removes them. No cloud synchronization.
Sudden process termination may return to the most recent completed checkpoint; Save & exit explicitly waits for confirmation.
No new full-match pacing sample in this follow-up; prior samples do not establish a 12-15-minute average or 20-minute exhaustion.
